propositions: Errored pairs are incorrectly counted as decision flips because parity.py:107 compares synthetic decisions from errored records against real model verdicts with no errored guard, causing a single transient error to fail criterion (b).

The filter at parity.py:105 admits pairs to gold_pairs based on gold label membership in _DECISIONS, not on decision field value, so changing the synthetic decision in fidelity_spot_eval.py:174 cannot prevent an errored pair from being counted as a flip.

An errored record with errored=True and valid=True produces a silent fabricated flip with no corroborating error-rate or validity signal, making it impossible for a reader to distinguish real flips from fabricated ones in multi-arm comparison.

The fix excludes gold pairs where either side has errored=True from decision_flips, counts them into a new errored_pairs metric, and surfaces that metric in ParityReport and gating strings so arms with different error/flip distributions are distinguishable.
